surf_princessburglar_b26.caveat: v14 alone ran on pb grids without the four walls (before the entity tag): like for like only before ~17% of the course - the room exit (0.4% -> 3.2%) and the x -1,005 wall (6.9% -> 15.3%); the shaft and the finish are the same physics with different depth, normal, potential and shaping grids. The ledger's 'room exit ~1.96B' and 'wall 9.59B (21.4%)' used other readings; by this rule v14 alone left the room at 1.284B (median episode 1.359B) and passed the wall at 9.287B
